name: cache-tax
description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks (/keepwarm) and shows a cold send's estimated rewrite cost; this copy warns by default instead of asking. Warming costs tokens. Copy of karanb192/cache-tax 2.4.0 (b05ec14).

autoWarm.title: Auto keepwarm
autoWarm.description: on: after you pay a cold cache write, keepwarm arms itself for eight hours (the default). off: keepwarm only runs when you arm it with /keepwarm.
